what: In records cleanup slice 5 the lead caught a builder's fold of 0535 that typed an hourly mutation interval, and sent its own wording back instead: mutation is started by main's scheduled clock, `scheduled.yaml`'s `on.push` and `on.schedule`. That made a push to main start mutation, which 0067 rules out (never by a push). The review sent it back, and fix round 1 names only the `on.schedule` cron.
cause: The lead wrote the fold from 0535 and 0581 alone, and did not read 0067, an amender of the same rule outside the slice's status lines.
fix: A lead-sent fold reads every record that rules on the same line, the ones outside the status lines included, before it is sent, as the review brief already asks of a reviewer.
test: The next lead-sent fold in a cleanup slice names the records it read in its message to the builder.
